about: Accepts a studio under 2,000, wants to be near an intersection, needs in-suite laundry, no calls

lines.say: I'm looking for a studio or anything bigger, as long as it's under 2,000 a month.
I work near King and Bay, so I'd like to be close to there.
And I really need laundry in the unit.
Thanks, I'll call back later. Bye.
